name: Norfolk Island
summary: Green, white and green vertical bands, the white wider, with a green Norfolk Island pine in the centre. The tree is the island's emblem.
origin: The flag was adopted on 15 June 1980, during the period of self-government granted by Australia in 1979.

symbols.name: Norfolk Island pine
symbols.description: A tall, symmetrical green pine (Araucaria heterophylla).
symbols.meaning: The island's native tree and emblem.

facts: Many islanders descend from the Bounty mutineers who moved from Pitcairn in 1856.
Nigeria's flag has the same green-white-green vertical layout without the tree.
Norfolk Island pines are grown worldwide as ornamental trees.
clues: Green, white and green vertical bands with a pine tree in the centre.
Many of its residents descend from mutineers.
Like Nigeria's flag with a tree added.
